notes: The verse writes mippenekhem twice: the first is rendered from before and split under rule 2, the second because of and fused under rule 30.
The cognate infinitive absolute takes the distinct adverbial certainly, the finite verb keeping it was told (rule 56).
The single determiner of ha-davar ha-zeh is the demonstrative's, so both articles are unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
